skills.name: Code Review
skills.trigger: Review current diff for bugs, style, or refactoring.
procedure: Read the current diff/changes.
Identify correctness bugs first, then reuse/efficiency issues.
Apply effort level: low/medium=high-confidence only, high/max=broader coverage.
Use --comment to post inline PR review comments.
Use --fix to apply findings directly to working tree.
skills.output: Ranked findings list; inline comments or applied fixes.
token_policy: Skip findings below confidence threshold for selected effort.
Link to source rather than quoting long context.
compatibility: Preserve existing /review skill for full PR review flow.
Do not overwrite existing dated skill snapshots.

skills.name: Goal
skills.trigger: User wants Claude to work autonomously until a condition is met.
procedure: Define the completion condition clearly.
Execute steps iteratively until condition is satisfied.
Report concise status at each iteration.
Stop and report when goal is met or if blocked.
skills.output: Completion status and summary of actions taken.
token_policy: Report progress in one line per step.
compatibility: Works with background sessions and worktrees.

skills.name: Reload Skills
skills.trigger: Skill files added or edited; reload without restart.
procedure: Re-scan .claude/skills/ directories.
Load newly added or modified skills.
Report which skills were loaded or updated.
token_policy: Return only the names of changed skills.
compatibility: SessionStart hook can also set reloadSkills: true.

skills.name: Model
skills.trigger: User wants to change the model for the current session.
procedure: Show available models.
Switch to selected model for current session only.
Press d to persist as default model.
compatibility: Does not affect other concurrent sessions.

skills.name: Scroll Speed
skills.trigger: User wants to tune mouse wheel scroll speed.
procedure: Open scroll speed adjustment with live preview.
Confirm setting.

skills.name: Workflows
skills.trigger: User wants to view dynamic workflow runs.
procedure: List active workflow runs.
Show status and progress of each workflow.
Allow navigation to individual workflow details.
token_policy: Summarize status; link to details rather than inline.
compatibility: Preview feature; requires dynamic workflows enabled.

skills.name: Voice
procedure: Toggle voice interaction mode.
Use microphone for input when enabled.
Speak responses when enabled.

skills.name: Login
skills.trigger: User needs to authenticate or switch accounts.
procedure: Trigger authentication flow.
Complete login via browser or token.
